Three posts, 7 cards. 3365 and 3162 had ZERO cards under the old decision-only rule and are the clearest evidence it was too narrow: 3365 ranks 4.0 on 'stress fracture shin' and 3162 sits at 9.8-10.5 on 'muscle strain treatment', which is striking distance. Cut on the read: 3978's two chest-pain candidates (759 and 1,276 impressions) because the post answers 'muscular or heart' with a three-way table one section down, so two one-sided cards would split an answer the body already gives whole. 3365's 'How Are Stress Fractures Diagnosed?' cut because the reader does not choose their own imaging and the section carries no rank evidence. 3921 and 3116 deferred: 3921 already has 4 cards including a thresholds card, and 3116 needs an operator decision first because it is 4 cards on a procedure this ER does not perform.
